labels.text: Article 1. Annulment of some documents and regulations on food safety The documents
labels.label: ESTABLISHES_STRUCTURE

labels.text: and regulations below are annulled:
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: 1. Article 2, Chapter I, Chapter IV and Chapter V of the Government’s Decree No. 67/2016/ND-
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: CP dated July 01, 2016 on requirements for food manufacturing and trading under specialized
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: management of the Ministry of Health.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: 2. Clause 2c, Article 5 of the Government’s Decree No. 15/2018/ND-CP dated February 02,
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: 2018 on elaboration of some articles of the Law on Food Safety (hereinafter referred to as
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: "Decree No. 15/2018/ND-CP).
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: 3. Circular No. 15/2012/TT-BYT dated September 12, 2012 of the Minister of Health providing
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: food safety requirements applied to food manufacturers and sellers.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: 4. Circular No. 16/2012/TT-BYT dated October 22, 2012 of the Minister of Health on food
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: safety conditions applicable to food manufacturers and sellers and food packing instruments and
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: materials under the management of the Ministry of Health.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: 5. Circular No. 26/2012/TT-BYT dated November 30, 2012 of the Minister of Health on
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: granting of food safety certificates for manufacturers and sellers of functional food, food with
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: micronutrients, food additives and food processing aids; still mineral water, bottled water; food
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: packaging instruments and materials under the management of the Ministry of Health.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: b. Import drugs as emergency aid or humanitarian aid, if approved by the regulatory agency.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: c. Clause 8a, Article 91 is amended as follows:
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: “a. The licensed import quantity of drugs that contain an active ingredient which is not granted
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: the certificate of drug registration or a herbal ingredient that is used in Vietnam for the first time
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: as specified in Article 65 hereof, depends on the business demand of the importer."
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: d. Clause 15, Article 91 is amended as follows;
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: “15. To be allowed to sign a contract with the importer, the foreign supplier of drugs/medicinal
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: ingredients must be:
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: a. A manufacturer of imported drugs/medicinal ingredients.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: b. The owner of the product or holder of the certificate of free sale of the imported drug or active
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: ingredient written on the Certificate of Pharmaceutical product, whether or not the drug is
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: granted the Certificate of Registration in accordance with the Law on Pharmacy.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: c. The applicant for registration of the drug or medicinal ingredient has the certificate of
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: registration in Vietnam which does not expire at the time customs clearance is granted. This
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: applicant must be other than those mentioned in Points a and b of this Clause.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: d. An establishment granted the License to trade drugs, medicinal ingredients, vaccines,
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: biologicals or ingredients thereof in Vietnam.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: dd. In cases specified in Points c, d or h of this clause, they are required to be authorized in
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: writing by the entity mentioned in Point a or b of this Clause to supply drugs in Vietnam. Except
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: for those specified in points d and h of this clause, they are specified in point a or b of this
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: clause.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: The authorization document may be an authorization letter, seller's license or certificate of
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: partnership. The authorization document must be written in Vietnamese or English and contain:
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: name and address of the authorizing party and authorized party; scope of supply of
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: drugs/medicinal ingredients in Vietnam; authorization period or sale period; responsibilities of
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: the parties for the quality and origins of drugs/medicinal ingredients supplied in Vietnam;
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: signatures of the parties.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: e. Regulations of this Clause do not apply to suppliers of imported drugs specified in Articles 67,
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: 73 and Clause 1, Article 74 hereof.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: g. Regulations of Point dd of this Clause do not apply to suppliers of imported drugs specified in
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: Articles 68 and 70 hereof.
labels.label: OTHER

labels.text: h. Establishments specified in Clause 22 hereof.”
